findings.title: Sitemap and robots point to localhost
findings.description: robots.txt declares http://localhost:3000/sitemap.xml; all 242 sitemap <loc> values use localhost. Deployed code falls back to localhost when NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL is unset.
findings.recommendation: Deploy local robots.ts/sitemap.ts and set NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL in Vercel Production.

findings.title: /contact returns 404
findings.description: Contact page exists only as an untracked local file.

findings.title: All pages uncached (no-store)
findings.description: force-dynamic yields Cache-Control no-store and x-vercel-cache MISS on 239/239; TTFB p90 668 ms, max 5.3 s; bfcache disabled.
findings.recommendation: Use ISR with existing revalidateTag invalidation.

findings.title: Catalog beyond first 12 products only via infinite scroll
findings.description: product-grid.tsx loads further pages through /api/catalog on scroll.

findings.title: Thin product descriptions
findings.description: 58% of descriptions under 50 words, 15% empty; short description equals title on 60%.
findings.recommendation: 60-150 unique words plus specs list, starting with top 50 products by views.

findings.title: Product names lack brand, scale and type
findings.description: 21% ALL CAPS; 10% three words or fewer (e.g. TWIN TAGS).
findings.recommendation: Brand + Series + Model + Colour + Scale + Die-Cast Car.

findings.title: Weak homepage title
findings.recommendation: Include Udaipur, Hot Wheels/diecast and store intent.

findings.title: Meta description duplicates title
findings.recommendation: Template with model, scale, price, store and shipping.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Local code already emits Product, Offer, BreadcrumbList, Organization, WebSite, ToyStore

findings.title: No structured data live
findings.description: 0 JSON-LD blocks on home, catalog and 239 product pages.

findings.title: Merchant listing fields incomplete in local code
findings.description: Validator: missing hasMerchantReturnPolicy and shippingDetails; no gtin/mpn/sku; PRE_ORDER mapped to InStock; no StrikethroughPrice.

findings.title: CWV not measured
findings.description: PSI keyless quota exceeded; score is an estimate.
findings.recommendation: Add PSI API key and re-run pagespeed_check.py.

findings.title: Few citable product facts
findings.description: Scale on 38% of products; no series, year or colour fields.
findings.recommendation: Add structured spec fields and render them.

findings.title: Single image per product
findings.description: Only 8% have more than one image.
findings.recommendation: 3+ angles; clean main image without text overlay.
